enum Planet {
  earth(5972, 6371),
  mars(642, 3389)
  ;
  final int mass;
  final int radius;
  const Planet(this.mass, this.radius);

  String describe() {
    return '${this.name}:${this.diameter}';
  }

  int get diameter {
    return this.radius * 2;
  }

  int get density {
    return this.mass ~/ this.radius;
  }

}
